result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly well-formed. The main visible defect is the empty profile/notification button at the top right. The carousels and the cut-off pizza card are expected scroll behavior and are not reported. A few minor polish concerns remain.

issues.description: The circular button at the top right is an empty gray circle with only a small red dot. It has no icon (profile, bell or cart), so its purpose is unclear. The red dot looks like a notification badge but is not attached to any icon. The icon is likely missing or failed to load.
issues.suggestion: Render the intended icon (e.g. bell or profile avatar) inside the circle and anchor the badge to the icon's corner. Add an accessibility label.

issues.description: The delivery-time pills on the 'Fastest near you' cards (e.g. '15–25 min') overlap the image and sit close to the card's bottom edge. On the first card the pill also overlaps the plate illustration.
issues.suggestion: Give the pills consistent inset padding from the card edges and position them so they don't cover the key part of the image.

issues.description: The gray secondary text (delivery fees, the '(500+)' rating count, the inactive tab labels and the search placeholder) has low contrast against the white or light-gray backgrounds. The white '€0 delivery' and '−20%' badges are also small.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text colors to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) and increase the badge text size slightly.

issues.description: The heart/favorite buttons on the cards are inconsistent. The one on the ramen card has a dark circular background that blends into the dark image, while the one on the pizza card has a different, more visible translucent circle. Both have weak visual definition.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent favorite-button style with a semi-transparent light background so it stands out on any image.
